title: Customer communications
heading: From request to a useful reply.
description: A service request stays alongside the customer message and a prepared response.
takeaway: Keep the conversation and next action together.

title: Sales preparation
heading: Context before the conversation.
description: Discovery questions turn a research brief into a focused conversation plan.
takeaway: Ask questions tied to the buyer's stated pain.

title: Operational visibility
heading: See the work across the business.
description: A shared control surface brings operational status and attention into one view.
takeaway: Give the operator a clear view of what needs attention.

title: Research workspace
heading: Make information navigable.
description: Organized evidence gives research a place to be reviewed and used.
takeaway: Keep the useful evidence close to the decision.
